lines.t: Walk not in your own way…
But come and walk with Me…
Walk not in your own way, let it fall behind
Lay down every burden, come and rest in Mine
I am calling gently, “Child, remember Me”
In the quiet stillness, there your soul is free
When you turn and listen, when your heart aligns
You will find My presence in My ways divine
Walk with Me in Mine, let your striving cease
Rest within My love, enter into peace
Honor Me in stillness, trust what I have said
You will surely be blessed when by Me you’re led
From the setting sunlight to the evening glow
I have marked a day for you to let things go
Remember and honor, keep this time with Me
Sanctified from the start, as it was meant to be
Those who choose to keep it, set their hearts apart
Find My rest abiding deep within their heart
Walk with Me in Mine, let your striving cease
Rest within My love, enter into peace
Honor Me in stillness, trust what I have said
You will surely be blessed when by Me you’re led
Six days you may carry every weight you bear
But the seventh is holy, leave it in My care
Lay your cross upon Me, let your soul be light
Rejoice and be merry, in My perfect sight
Look toward the promise, toward that coming Day
All who rest within Me will not drift away
I have set it apart… from the very beginning…
Come and rest… come and rest in Me…
Walk with Me in Mine, let your striving cease
Rest within My love, enter into peace
Honor Me in stillness, trust what I have said
You will surely be blessed when by Me you’re led
Walk not in your own way…
But walk with Me in Mine…
And rest…
Just rest…
In Me…
